channel.title: PHP October 2026: updates
channel.description: PHP October 2026: what changed on the site, in the story and across the team, hourly, daily and flash.

item.title: Daily: The first day: 34 releases, a fact-check that corrected the site, still no confirmed compromise, and nine decisions waiting on the editor
item.description: The site went from nothing to 391 pages in about ten hours, and its own fact-check desk found that 11 of its 70 claims say more than their evidence. In the story, php2shell is still not on CISA's exploited list and no organisation has confirmed a compromise; the evidence on the site has not been refreshed since 11:34 UTC.
